Love my Duet!!

I have used my duet quite a lot as both a walker and transport chair. It's been a life saver on 2 cruises with excursions, airplanes 8 times, of course left at the door of the plane to be placed below during the flights, weddings, a funeral and in and out of our cars about a million times. When I am feeling well enough to drive, I am able to slide it in and out of my trunk alone, as long as I can sit on my bumper! Very easy fold/unfold and secure lock in both positions. Like other reviewers, i would love to see a cushioned seat and larger, shock absorbing wheels as being a rider over bumpy terrain, like brick walkways, can be jarring. Going through doorways with any sort of threshold or the many seams in a ships construction, must be navigated backward for ease and safety. And the first time we used it as a chair and, of course were late for a doctor appointment and going over cracked asphalt, I found myself (the passenger) sprawled out on the ground because a front wheel got caught in a crack. But I still love it! We just know it's limitations. So, are there things that could be improved? Yes. But there isn't anything else on the market that gives me the freedom of walking when I can and the security of being able to sit or ride when I need to, with this durability for the price!!

by Shananigan

Drive Duet Rollator/Transport Chair - Just Walkers

 

# Drive Duet Rollator/Transport Chair

$199.99

▼ The Details
: The Drive Duet Transport Chair/Rollator combines all the features of a 4 wheel rollator and transport chair in one unit! 

With the Drive Duet Transport Chair/Rollator, an individual can ambulate independently or, if need be, be pushed safely by a caregiver. The contoured, padded backrest is reversible depending on whether you are using the Duet in rolling walker or transport chair mode. The transition is easy and requires no tools. Both modes make use of the ergonomic handles, large 8” wheels, and secure loop-lock brakes.

When used as a transport wheelchair, this rollator combination features a fold-down footrest for better comfort. Both the seat and the curved backrest are padded for comfort. This 4 wheel walker will work equally well both indoors and out, making it extremely versatile.

The Drive Duet Rollator/Transport Chair also features a large under-seat pouch for the safe storage of personal items. Inside the pouch is a handle to aid with the folding of the chair. The folding frame has a lock out feature to ensure the walking aid stays open while in use and folded during transport.

#### Highlights

- Combines the features of a Rollator and transport chair in one unit
- Locking flip-up armrests and flip-down footrest are used in transport chair mode and are easily removed and stowed away in Rollator mode
- Tool-free, two-position contoured padded backrest

#### Description

Experience the convenience and value of two outstanding products in a single safe, convenient aid to improving daily mobility with the Duet Rollator/Transport Chair from Drive Medical. As a Rollator, the Duet surpasses a standard walker by eliminating the need to lift the device and allowing you to walk with an easy, smooth gait. It handles uneven, outdoor terrain with ease and provides a comfortable and convenient place to rest with its cushioned seat. But the Duet is also a transport chair, making it great for being escorted around your home, or around the shopping mall. Simply lift the armrests, shift the backrest and lower the footrest into place, and your Duet is now a comfortable seat for you while a caregiver easily pushes you.

### Frequently Asked Questions 

 How does the Duet switch from a rollator to a transport chair? 

Conversion is tool free. Lift the armrests, shift the two-position contoured backrest, and lower the footrest into place, and the Duet becomes a transport chair so a caregiver can push you. To go back to rollator mode, the flip-up armrests and flip-down footrest are easily removed and stowed away.

 Can the Duet be used outdoors? 

Yes. The 8" casters are designed for both indoor and outdoor use, and the Duet handles uneven outdoor terrain with ease. As a rollator it also eliminates the need to lift the device, so you can walk with an easy, smooth gait.

 Are the handles height adjustable? 

Yes. The handles adjust in height using a self-threading knob, so no tools are required to set them to a comfortable position.

 Does the Duet fold for storage and transport? 

Yes. The folding frame includes a lock-out feature that keeps the unit open while it is in use and keeps it folded during transport.

 Is the Duet Rollator/Transport Chair FSA or HSA eligible? 

This product is listed as FSA and HSA eligible on the product page. Eligibility can vary by plan, so confirm with your FSA or HSA plan administrator before purchasing to make sure the item qualifies for reimbursement under your specific plan.
